Exact worktree C:/Users/zFlei/repos/lux/.worktrees/receiver-diagnostics, branchcodex/receiver-diagnostics baselinef3983b0. Six owned files: new native/ffgl-source/src/ReceiverRun.h, modified FrameReceiver.cpp, new tests/native/receiver_run_test.cc, modified tests/native/receiver_lifecycle_test.cc, additive native/CMakeLists.txt target/test registration, native/LIFECYCLE.md. Distinguish pending requested stop from failed/complete/deadline copy outcomes; production helper separately contains diagnostic callback exceptions before existing cleanup; hoisted counters and current-run beginSucceeded guard prevent stale activation attribution; bounded JSON formatter preserves valid failure rows under normal output. Add production-used seam tests for outcome matrix, callback throw/order, formatter controls/truncation, activation attribution and pending/failed ownership retention. No GPU resource completion or timing success inferred from stop/logging. Required focused CPU tests and LuxTracerTR02 build exactly as plan, plus unchanged JS inspector negative tests. No native host, GPU, Studio, Resolume or native filesystem scope. Source-level implementation acceptance requires exact commit/build/test/raw evidence and fresh independent review; root owns separate integration. Vendor prerequisite prepared by root: copied source-only FFGL203files atfda8d4a to isolated native/vendor/ffgl/source/lib, full verified hashes in main docs/conductor-onboarding/receiver-vendor-source-manifest.json. Inspect manifest/destination before build. Do not copy old binaries, download/install, alter reserved C02/source/runtime files, merge or push. User authorizes four-workstream continuation and routine decisions under sole root coordinator.
